Colour

Where a balayage's time goes

Most of a colour appointment is waiting for chemistry. We tell you how long the processing takes before you book, so you can plan the rest of your day.

Balayage3 h 40 minlong hair · Noor

Balayage, long hair: 3 h 40 min

10Painting 75Lift 45Toner 25Cut 65
  • Consultation and a strand test - 10 min
  • Sectioning and hand-painting - 75 min
  • Processing: the lightener lifts (45 min), then the toner sets (20 of 25 min) - you read, we bring coffee
  • Rinse, cut and blow-dry - 65 min
Processing times for colour - the time the colour works while you wait.
Colour service Processing
Root colour 35 min
Full colour 40 min
Balayage 45 + 20 min
Gloss & toner 20 min
Plant-based colour (henna, indigo) 60-90 min

Privacy

What we keep, and for how long.

Bookings

Your name, phone and email are used for the appointment and one reminder. We delete them two years after your last visit.

Your colour card

The formula we mixed for you is kept so we can mix it again. Ask at reception and we print it for you or delete it.

Cookies

This site sets none. The look and light or dark mode you pick are not stored.

Your rights

Write to hello@juniper-shear.example to see, correct or delete what we hold about you.
